mechanism: Cimetidine reduces intrinsic factor and gastric acid secretion, impairing the absorption of cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12), which requires intrinsic factor for ileal absorption.
action: Monitor serum B12 levels in patients on chronic cimetidine therapy; consider alternative H2-blockers or proton pump inhibitors if B12 deficiency develops, or supplement with parenteral cyanocobalamin if needed.
